profile.headline: College of Computing at Georgia Institute of Technology

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Built scalable banking microservices and REST APIs with Java and Spring Boot, ensuring backward compatibility
•	Use React and JSX to implement pages for token authentication system ensuring ease of user experience
•	Validate codebase with JUnit and perform API testing with Postman to ensure functionality 
•	Monitored and debugged application issues using Google Cloud Logging

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
•	Utilized Java along with the MapStruct library to seamlessly map between two object versions, ensuring a seamless transition during migration phases
•	Ensured the robustness of the codebase through comprehensive testing with JUnit, achieving a high functional coverage of at least 95%
•	Validated the accuracy and reliability of endpoints using Postman
•	Utilized JavaScript and Thyme Leaf to showcase the model mapper conversions on a local server
•	Engaged in an Agile development cycle, employing JIRA to effectively manage tasks, and collaborated closely with the Scrum Master to swiftly identify and address any impediments
positions.insights: Skills: JavaScript · Agile Software Development · Java · JUnit

positions.title: Technology, Data, and Innovation Summer Analyst
positions.locationName: Cary, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
•	Collaborated with software engineers, designers, and QAs to develop Global Receipt Platform website using React
•	Practiced agile with biweekly sprints to delegate and plan out daily tasks using Jira platform
•	Utilized Beautiful Soup to web scrape Deutsche Bank and four of its competitor’s newsroom articles to collect data
•	Analyzed sentiments of the data articles using Google Cloud Natural Language API
•	Created a data frame using python and graphed the sentimental competitor analysis using Plotly Dash
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · JavaScript · Plotly · Web Application Development · Node.js · Agile Software Development

positions.title: Building Manager
positions.description:
•	Managed two campus buildings and provided security checks and reported minor and major breaches to manager 
•	Provided customer care to increase customer experience satisfaction in the student recreation center 
•	Analyzed emergency situations and provided solutions throughout the building 
•	Trained new employees by providing guidance and instruction throughout their new role and maintained a positive work atmosphere

positions.title: Marketing Intern
positions.description:
•	Designed and strategized marketing techniques using VerticalResponse for organizations that are members of the Georgia River Network 
•	Performed data reconciliation and QA on the organizations’ mailing datasets to effectively send communications throughout the organization
•	Managed organizations’ social media platforms including Instagram and Facebook

positions.title: Cashier + Kitchen employee
positions.description:
•	Communicated efficiently with customers by taking orders in a positive spirit to increase customer satisfaction
•	Collaborated with coworkers to distribute workload, maintain team spirit, and keep positive attitude through a fast-paced environment
•	Led new employees throughout the onboarding process to help with training and increase productivity throughout the new transition

educations.schoolName: Honors Student at University of Georgia

volunteerExperiences.description:
•	Tutored students (Grade 6-8) math concepts every week
•	Researched best teaching methods and tailored different techniques for the need of the individual students
•	Led groups that included 50+ children between ages 3 to 5 throughout daily activities
